results.summary_before: This is a demoscene demo for Tiny Tapeout that generates both VGA video and audio, using the Tiny VGA and audio PMODs. It is written in Silice and can be simulated on an ECPIX5 with a VGA PMOD and an I2S audio PMOD, or the audio can run on an ULX3S using its DAC. The documentation is minimal, consisting mainly of a rhetorical question and a note that it works as expected when tested with the PMODs. The design is notable for being part of a demoscene competition and for combining video and audio in a small area.

results.summary_before: This project implements a modified Izhikevich neuron model in 22-bit fixed-point arithmetic to capture various spiking behaviors. It uses select pins to choose neuron parameters and five input pins for current injection, with outputs for membrane potential and recovery variable. The design is intended for simulating spiking cortical neurons in digital hardware, and external observation requires inverting the outputs and connecting to an oscilloscope. The documentation includes equations and a testbench description, but no silicon test results are provided.
